security.staffNeverAsk: EventDesk staff will never ask you for this code — not by phone, email or chat. Do not share it with anyone.
security.notRequested: If you did not request this code, someone is probing your email address. You do not need to do anything: without the code they cannot get in.
security.notRequestedAction: If you did not request this code, someone is trying to change something in your account. Do not share the code, and sign out of all devices from the “Account” page.
